title: Shinonome Akito — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Do you all have your drinks?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, to Akito's happy birthday—

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A toast♪

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Akito!
We all got together and made this five-stack of pancakes for you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Look at that! Each one is so soft and fluffy that the whole stack wobbles every time KAITO takes a step!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's some impressive volume... Not just the pancakes themselves, but all the whipped cream and fruit on top, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So you say, but I bet you're gonna demolish that whole stack on your own, easy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As if. What do you think I am, huh?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right, here you are. The special stack for the birthday boy! Eat up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Here are yours, Toya. Extra fruit on top, easy on the whipped cream and with less sugar in the batter.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
The fruits are arranged so beautifully, too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And they're all even cut into decorative shapes, aren't they? Did you all work on these together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO cut the fruit, but Luka showed me how to do the arranging. It was tricky, so I'm glad you like it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Isn't it so aesthetic?
Look, I'm especially proud of this bit here♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: The two of us worked really hard, too! Aren't all these decorations in the cafe nice and sparkly?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone worked so hard to make Akito happy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I see. Uh, well... You know. Thanks, guys.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Now, let's all dig in!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Let's. Here goes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Actually... Where did An get off to?
MEIKO's been gone for a bit now too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Akito, can we have a sec? We've got something you'll want to see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? What's with the showboating?
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm? We'll see if you're singing the same tune once you see this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ta-da! Does this cake look familiar?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is this...a cheesecake?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wow, it looks delicious!
Did you make this, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I did! Well, MEIKO helped me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I made the sour cream from scratch, and getting the cream cheese to fold in without lumps was hard. I worked for this, you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sour cream from scratch...
Hey, wait a minute.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is this... Ken's cheesecake?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ding ding ding! It's my Dad's recipe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm impressed, Akito. How did you know?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's just that I remember Ken saying his place's cheesecake uses handmade sour cream.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't think it could be, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've always loved Dad's cheesecake, right? That's why I asked him for the recipe and gave it a shot!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We know that flavor means a lot to you, so An and I worked very hard to recreate it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, you know... It'd be a bit boring to just let you have it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's sing for it. You versus me.
If you win, you can have the whole thing all to yourself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, wasn't the whole point of bugging Ken and MEIKO to help you with this for me to eat it?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh, I don't recall ever saying that.
Well, we don't have to, if you're scared you're going to lose.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, very original.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, I'll bite. Explain your rules.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The rules are simple. We both sing, and whoever gets the room more hyped is the winner. Sound fair?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, fine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys.
You heard her, you're judging.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, you're singing?
Let us sing, too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! It's not fair that only you and An get to sing. And the winner gets the whole cheesecake, too?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, come on. If everyone gets involved, who's going to decide who the winner is?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It'll be fine. We'll all be able to tell while we're singing anyway... And either way, I want to get in on this too♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I swear, Luka...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it's more like a party if we all sing together, right? And I just so happen to have the perfect track.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, nice. Give us something with a good beat, okay?
Kohane, Toya, are you two in?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I would like to join. As his partner, I can't leave Akito to sing on his own.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And... If I win, I can give Akito the cheesecake as a present.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Then sure, I'll sing too.
The cake does look good...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I also think that all of us singing together will feel even more like a celebration for Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I feel like you're all totally losing the plot here. Don't blame me if this ends up in chaos.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright. Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes.
Of course!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mm, that really felt good!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So much for a birthday, huh? That was just what we do every day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But hey, I guess that's just like us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And you looked like you were having fun the whole time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, who won in the end?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm, I thought we'd be able to tell while we were singing... But I was having so much fun, I totally forgot about the contest♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
See, what did I say?
But it's true, it was hard to tell. Everyone's singing melded together as one.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, that answers that, then. Go grab me a knife and enough plates for everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you're not planning to keep it all to yourself?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why would I do that? The contest's a wash anyway. And besides...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It'd be a waste to hog a cake that looks this good.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I got you. One sec!
se_run_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, be careful not to trip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This cheesecake gets me thinking... These guys really are always looking out for me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (After RAD BLAST, a lot of stuff has changed for all of us...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I get the feeling they'll always be here, just like this.)
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Akito! I got the plates and serving knife!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An, let me help you with that! We can split them up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then I'll help MEIKO and the others get fresh drinks made for everyone. You must all be thirsty after all that singing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks. I'll have the cake cut in a flash, so take the plates and pass 'em down.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito! Once again, happy birthday! Did you enjoy your birthday show?! We already have plans for a continuation, so why don't we present it on your next birthday?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Excellent idea. I'll have to use every trick in my book to make sure Shinonome really enjoys himself.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow, we're already working on a sequel?! Let's make it even more exciting and smiley for Akito, then☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
This is the first I'm hearing about this...
Anyway, Shinonome, I'm sure we'll be back to trouble you again, so thanks for always being so patient.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday. There's cheesecake in the fridge, so eat it when you get back. I bought it with Airi and the others from a trendy shop.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akito! You should have seen how focused Ena was picking out a cake for you. Be sure to tell her later if you enjoyed it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday! From what Ena says, you're throwing yourself into your studies and your music. I hope today you can relax and refresh yourself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Proper rest is an important part of both studying and working out. These protein bars are specially formulated to provide BCAA, and should help reduce your fatigue. Please give them a try.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wow, even Haruka's presents are made for self-improvement... Meanwhile, Honami and I got you these colorful flying disc cookies!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hanasato and I weren't sure what you would like, but then we realized that these would be perfect for the three of us. I really hope you like them, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday. I was wondering why Ena was putting so much research into cheesecake... But I see it was for her present to you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Akito! We sang a bunch and ate a ton... Isn't that just how we roll? I was really happy to hear you liked the cheesecake!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shinonome! Today was so much fun. I'm glad we got to sing together. Thanks for everything you do!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Happy birthday. I couldn't be happier to get to celebrate your birthday with so many people, both at school and in SEKAI. Remember, partner, I'm always here for you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for going to all this trouble, guys.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: First at school, then in SEKAI, it's been one noisy day...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, that's not too bad every once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But, we can't afford to lose our edge.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll take a short break, but once things have settled down, we're going right back to full speed ahead.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll stick around.
